layman_headline: All three positions are in profit — let winners ride while the market surges.
layman_explanation: Bitcoin just broke above $75,000 and the entire crypto market is rallying hard. Our three open trades — Ethereum, Solana, and Hyperliquid — are all in the green but still early in their moves toward our profit targets. The market mood has shifted rapidly from neutral to greedy in just a week, which means things could keep running but we also need to be careful about chasing new entries at these elevated levels.
layman_action: Hold all three current positions and let them work toward their exit targets. No new buys right now — everything has moved too fast in the last week to chase safely. Tighten mental stops if momentum fades.
expert_reasoning: All three portfolio positions are performing well: ETH +4.2%, SOL +2.2%, HYPE +0.4%. The broad market rally driven by BTC breaking $75K is lifting all boats. However, every swing candidate on the watchlist has already moved 17-46% in 7 days, making new entries at current levels a poor risk/reward proposition. Fear & Greed jumped from 45.7 weekly average to 72, a rapid sentiment shift that historically precedes short-term pullbacks. The prudent move is to hold existing positions, which were entered at better prices, and wait for a consolidation or pullback to deploy the remaining capital. High BTC dominance at 59% also suggests alts may underperform on continued rallies.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed surging from 45 to 72 in one week suggests potential for a sentiment-driven pullback
BTC dominance at 59% means capital is flowing to Bitcoin over alts — our three alt positions could lag
All major assets are extended 17-30% on the week with no consolidation — risk of a sharp retracement
watch_list: Whether BTC holds above $73,000 support — a break below could trigger alt selloff hitting our stops
ETH approaching $2,400-2,500 resistance zone — watch for signs of profit-taking or breakout
Fear & Greed index — if it pushes above 80 (Extreme Greed), consider taking partial profits on positions
market_context: Bitcoin has surged past $75K with a golden cross forming, pulling the entire market into a strong rally. Sentiment has shifted rapidly to Greed territory, and while momentum is bullish, the speed of the move warrants caution on new entries.
context_banner: Strong BTC-led rally with all positions in profit — discipline says hold winners and avoid chasing extended moves.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed jumped from weekly avg of 45.7 to 72 (Greed), a rapid shift that historically signals caution for new entries but supports holding existing positions.
Bitcoin pushing past $75K with a golden cross pattern and strategists targeting $180K provides strong macro tailwind for existing long positions.
The only candidate with RSI data (PUMP at 75, MON at 41, ENA at 44) shows either overbought or recently-extended conditions, none offering clean entry setups.
Ethereum upgrade news (turning 2-second block bottleneck into 9-second window) supports holding ETH position but is already partially priced into the 24.5% weekly move.
Massive volume across BTC ($60B), ETH ($25B), and XRP ($7.8B) confirms the rally has real participation, supporting continuation of current trends.
